title: Nashville 3BR · Pool & Indoor Pool · Nashville
description:
In Nashville, close to Broadway's honky-tonks, the Ryman, Bridgestone Arena and the Cumberland riverfront. 3-bedroom, 3-bath suite at our resort in Nashville, TN. Sleeps 8. Resort amenities include bbq grills, playground, picnic area and outdoor pool. Message us with any questions before you book.

The space
In the suite: Air conditioning · Bathtub · Bed linens · Body soap · Cable TV · Ceiling fan · Coffee · Coffee maker · Conditioner · Cookware · Dining table · Dishes and silverware · In-suite washer/dryer · DVD player · Essentials · Freezer · Hair dryer · Hangers · Heating · Wi-Fi · Iron · Full kitchen · Microwave · Oven · Pack ’n Play/travel crib · Refrigerator · In-room safe · Shampoo · Stove · TV · Toaster · Towels provided

Guest access
Check-in is at the resort's front desk. All resort amenities are open to you for the whole stay.
• Valet is the only parking the resort offers.
• Groceries and shopping are a short drive from the resort.
• We need the check-in guest's name in advance, and they must be 21 or older.

Other things to note
• This is a timeshare week rented from the owner, not a booking through the resort. You still check in at the front desk and use the resort normally.
• Photos show the resort and this unit type. The resort assigns the exact suite, so yours may differ slightly from the pictures.
• The resort chooses the exact suite within the unit type booked. A specific location isn't guaranteed.
• Some units of this type are mobility-accessible. Tell us if you need one or would rather not.
• Check-in requires a guest aged 21 or over with a credit card for the refundable damage deposit.
• You'll sign the resort's registration form at check-in and pay any local taxes or resort fees there.
• You may be invited to a timeshare presentation on arrival. It's optional.
• Refunds follow the cancellation policy on this listing.
• Resort information is supplied by the resort; message us to verify anything important.
